title: Independent follow cameras
summary: Named target tracking, independent view state and optional flight-specific focus.

blocks.text: view.camera@1.0.0 supplies independent camera instances by viewport identity. Bind any named target with focus(id); frame receives read-only system-metre positions and radians through transform(id), elapsed wall seconds and viewport CSS pixels. It never steps a world. Missing targets retain the last view; focus(undefined) enters a free stationary view. Each view keeps its own zoom and orientation. Returned frame storage is reused: copy it only when retaining historical snapshots.

The same package supplies the explicit view.flight-camera@1.0.0 adapter used by flight-split. It preserves body-relative ship following, horizon orientation, planet/free views, module camera modes, focus, smart throw and rebasing. Generic consumers need no ship, body, flight state or physics API. Flight target selection stays in this adapter.

initialZoom, referenceMetres and orientationSeconds configure presentation defaults. Existing flight defaults are 10, 1500 metres and 0.12 wall seconds. Each instance owns presentation state; dispose releases target and fling state, and provider removal disposes its instances. No renderer, DOM, device, simulation state or saved vehicle identity is owned here. A local-view composition declares a required view.camera provider; removing it gives dependency recovery rather than silently selecting a different provider.
